About Company Text:
Travel Food Services is one of the fast-growing Indian airport travel quick service restaurant (Tarvel QSR) and lounge sectors based on fiscal 2024 revenues.

Travel QSR Business: The company offers a range of curated food & beverage (F&B) across different cuisines and formats. As of June 30, 2024, the company has 397 Travel QSRs across 14 airports in India, 30 outlets across two airports in Malaysia and 32 outlets across eight highway sites in India.

It has 14 travel QSRs and lounge businesses across 14 airports in India including Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Chennai and 3 in Malaysia.

Its partner brands include KFC, Pizza Hut, Subway, Third Wave Cofee, Bikanervala, Wow Momo, Krispy Kreme, etc. and in-house brands include Caféccino, Dilli Streat, idli.com, and Curry Kitchen.

Lounge Business:The company has 31 lounges, with 24 in 8 airports in India and 3 in Malaysia.

Crizac Ltd is a B2B education platform for agents and global institutions for higher education in countries, like UK, Canada, Republic of Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

In the fiscal 2025, it has sourced enrolment from 75+ countries. In fiscal 2025, the company has processed over 7.11 lak applications with over 173 global institutions of higher education.

As of March 31, 2025, the company has 10,362 registered agents with 3,948 active agents during Fiscal 2025. Some of the global instiutions registered with the company include University of Birmingham, University of Surrey, University of Sunderland, Nottingham Trent University, University of Greenwich, University of West London, University of Portsmouth, De Montfort University, Glasgow Caledonian University, Aston University, University of Dundee, Dundalk Institute of Technology, and Coventry University and Swansea University.

Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd is manufactures crop protection products, plant nutrients, and biologicals. The company manufactures and markets an extensive range of products such as water dispersible granules (“WDG”), suspension concentrate (“SC”), capsule suspension (“CS”), ultra low volume (“ULV”), emulsion in water (“EW”), soluble granule (“SG”), flowable suspension (“FS”), etc.

The products offered by the company are used for various crops, including cereals, pulses and oilseeds, fibre crops, plantations, and fruits and vegetables.

It served both domestic and international customers, such as Krishi Rasayan Exports Private Limited, Delhi, Parijat Industries (India) Private Limited, Delhi, BR Agrotech Private Limited, Delhi, Crystal Crop Protection Limited, Delhi, and Asasiat of Development for Agric & Trade Co., UAE.

Currently, the company operates four manufacturing facilities in Samba, Jammu and Kashmir; (ii) Nathupur - I, Haryana; (iii) Nathupur - II, Haryana; and (iv) Barwasni, Haryana across 20 acres of land. Its manufacturing facility is certified with ISO 9001: 2015 and ISO 14001: 2015.

Sambhv Steel Tubes manufactures electric resistance welded steel pipes and structural tubes in India. It source iron ore from Navratna PSU mines and coal from Maharatna PSU.

As of March 31, 2024, it has 33 distributors across 6 branches in 15 states and 1 union territory.

It has a manufacturing facility in Sarora, Tilda, Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

HDB Financial is one of the leading non-banking financial companies in India in terms of total gross loan book. It is an upper layer NBFC by the RBI. The company offers various lending solutions, like;

As of Sep 30, 2024, its gross loan book value accounted for 39.85% enterprise lending, 37.36% asset finance, and 22.79% from consumer finance.

Additionally, the company also offers business process outsourcing (BPO) services as back-office support services, collection and sales support services, etc.

Globe Civil Project is an integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company. The company is engaged in infrastructure projects, like Transport and logistics projects, social and commercial projects, and non-infrastructure projects like commercial offices and housing.

The company has also diversified into specialized infrastructure and non-infrastructure projects like railway bridges, airport terminal, elevated railway terminal, and railway bridges and hospitals.

Additionally, the company also provides mechanical, electrical, and plumbing, architectural and structural work, etc

It is also a registered Class-1 Super contractor with the Central Public Work Department (“CPWD”), Government of India to tender for any work up to Rs 650 crore.

Ellenbarrie industrial is an Indian-owned industrial gas company in terms of installed manufacturing capacity.

The company manufactures and supply a range of industrial gases, like oxygen, carbon dioxide, acetylene, nitrogen, helium, hydrogen, argon and nitrous oxide, as well as dry ice, synthetic air, fire-fighting gases, medical oxygen, liquid petroleum gas, welding mixture and speciality gases.

It also offers turnkey solutions medical gas pipeline systems, where we assist healthcare facilities in designing, installing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of medical gas pipeline systems.

The company serves private and public entities across industries, like steel, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, engineering and infrastructure, aviation and aerospace, defence, etc.

In Fiscal 2024, the company has served 1,836 customers.

Kalpataru Ltd is an integrated real estate developer company in in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (“MMR”) in Maharashtra. It primarily focuses on development of luxury, premium, and mid-income residential, commerical and retail projects. The company has build different types of properties such as villas, duplexes, apartments, and plots.

As of March 31, 2024, it has completed 113 projects, aggregating the total value of more than 24.10 msf of Developable Area within Mumbai, Thane, Panvel and Pune in Maharashtra, and Hyderabad, Indore, Bengaluru, and Jodhpur. Its ongoing projects comprised of 22.02 msf of Developable Area and forthcoming projects for 19.93 msf of Developable Area.

Cryogenic OGS provides high-quality measurement and filtration equipment and systems by fabrication and assembling for various sectors like oil, gas, chemicals and allied fluid industry.

Its comprehensive solutions include design, process engineering and manufacturing including fabrication, assembly and testing facilities.

Key Products:

Its production facility is located at vadodara, Gujarat with over 8300 square meters, well equipped with advanced machineries and equipment. It is certified with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001: 2018, and ISO 14001:2015.

The company primarily secure contracts through a competitive tender bidding process. The company has secured more than 70 tenders/quotations worth Rs 28.37 crores and 9 quotes from international customers with Rs 26.76 crores.

Silky Overseas is a manfuacturer and supplier of bedding essentials, specializing in blankets, bed sheets, comforters, etc. under the brand name, "Rian Décor".

Its diversified product portfolio includes various items like blankets, baby blankets, comforters, bedsheets and curtains. The company manufactures products based on the customer demands. It also procure products directly from the local market and sell them to customers without modification.

It has strong market presence in the state of Haryana. Furthermore, it has distributors in other states such as West Bengal, Assam, Punjab, New Delhi, Bihar etc. Additionally, it sells products over e-commerce platforms like Flipkart, Ajio, Amazon, Walmart, etc.

Vandan Foods Ltd is engaged in the trading of agro commodities.

From fiscal 2024, the company has also started manufacturing castor oil. Currently, it operates on a B2B business model, focusing on Refined F.S.G. Castor Oil, Castor De Oil Cake.

The castor oil is used in the production of synthetic resins, plastics, fibres, paints, varnishes and various chemicals including drying oils and plasticizers.

The company's manufacturing facility is located at Dhinoj Patan, Gujarat.

Cedaar Textile manufactures and sells its products like Yarn, Technical Textile IFR, Fabrics, and Dyed Yarn. The company offers different types of yarns, such as Raw white Yarns, Melange Yarns, Solid Top dyed Yarns, and Grey Fancy Yarns in Cotton, Polyester, Acrylic, Viscose, Tencel, Modal, and other Fibers.

The Melange Yarn is used in household textile, woven goods, and hosiery. The company sources raw material from domestic sources, then process it via Tuft Blender, Blow Room, Carding, Breaker Drawing Frame, Finisher Drawing Frame, Simplex, Ring Frame, etc.

It sells products across the country such as Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, and other states. Also, it exports to several countries including Bangladesh, Singapore, Chile, Italy, Panama, Netherland, China, Morocco, etc.

Marc Loire Fashions Limited is engaged in Women's footwear products. The company opffers broad spectrum of footwear products, including party heels, ethnic flats, wedges, winter boots, mules, formal heels, loafers, cork sandals, arc-supported flats, athleisure and activewear footwear, sneakers, and other styles.

The company operates on both the Direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business to business (B2B) model. Under the D2C model, it sells products online and under the B2B model, it sell products through offline retail relationships with wholesalers and Shop-in-Shop (SIS) Stores.

Pushpa Jewellers is a prominent jewellery maker in India. The company designs different types of jewellery items such as traditional jewellery and modern gold jewellery.

Its product portfolio includes a diverse range of products like necklaces, rings, earrings, bangles, bracelets, pendants, Mangal sutras, and kadas. Its jewellery has world's finest stones like Emerald, Jade, pearl and meena.

The company sells products across India and export also in international markets such as Dubai, United States and Australia.

Currently, the company has three branches which are office cum showrooms in Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai. The company has in-house design and stream lined production team, and also outsource manfuacturing operations through Karigars as job workers.

Adcounty Media is a BrandTech company focused on providing end-to-end solutions to brands. The company offersmobile apps, programmatic tool called Bidcounty, and branding campaigns services.

Its range of services include rogrammatic Advertising and Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) to boost organic traffic, social media marketing and improve brand awareness; Pay Per Click (PPC), Cost Per Acquisition (“CPA”), Cost Per Sale (“CPS”), Cost Per Lead (CPL), and Cost Per Install (CPI) campaigns that aid sales, lead generation, user acquisition and re-targeting.
